newsitem.title: USA: Hicks Muse buys controlling stake in Vidrio.
newsitem.headline: Hicks Muse buys controlling stake in Vidrio.

text.p: Hicks, Muse, Tate & Furst Inc, a private investment firm, said on Friday it has acquired a controlling interest in Vidrio Formas SA de CV, a Mexico City-based supplier of glass containers.
Financial terms of the transaction were not disclosed. Both Hicks Muse and Vidrio Formas are privately held.

Founded in 1988 by the Bernstein family, Vidrio Formas is a suppliers of glass containers to Mexico's specialty producers in the country's tequila industry. The company also supplies glass containers to the food and pharmaceutical industries, Hicks Muse said.

The investment by Hicks Muse will allow Vidrio Formas to increase its production capacity through the expansion of its furnace and the installation of an additional glass-forming line and to upgrade its glass-forming equipment, Hicks Muse said.
